note: Scripted recognizer + fake speech synthesis + stubbed provider via the real server. Not real-device or real-audio evidence.

latency.label: SIMULATED — scripted recognizer final → UI/speech; real server, stubbed provider, loopback network
latency.excludes: microphone capture, real recognizer latency (cloud ASR typically adds hundreds of ms to seconds), real provider latency, Bluetooth output latency

steps.name: Home → "Translate what’s around you" opens setup; nothing is listening yet
Start → ambient disclosure first; no recognizer before Allow
8 Hungarian phrases → English text and speech, in order, once each (half-duplex: no headphones)
while a translation is spoken (no headphones), the recognizer is off; it comes back after
a long run-on is translated in stable pieces before the speaker stops, without repeating words
the room speaking English instead → a hint offers to switch (never switches by itself)
Speak translations off → text only; nothing new is spoken
Pause stops the recognizer at once; Resume starts listening again
settings: processing mode and where each step runs; On-device pauses listening (no on-device Hungarian)
leaving the page (hidden) pauses listening; it stays paused when visible again
Clear removes every line; nothing from the room is in browser storage
Back stops listening and speaking; the tab no longer says Listening
